change_summary: PLOS ONE has issued an Expression of Concern on this LSD1 lung cancer paper. It flags an apparent discontinuity in the Fig. 4 blot and a Fig. 7 that lacks the LSD1 siRNA data its text describes. It also flags missing control details for the transfection experiments and similarities to other groups' work that question the validity and provenance of the results. The authors did not respond. The paper has not been retracted, but the concern covers the figures and the provenance of the findings and is unresolved.
evaluation: The draft cites Lv et al. twice. In Section 2 it uses the tissue and survival findings as background. In Section 3 it treats the H460 siRNA scratch-assay result (Figure 7) as the main evidence for its central hypothesis. The Expression of Concern says Fig. 7 has no LSD1 siRNA data, that the transfection controls are poorly described, and that the provenance of the results is in doubt. That hits the Section 3 rationale hardest, and the concern is unresolved but the paper is not retracted. Overall the impact is medium: the draft's own experiments are planned independently, but its motivating evidence is weakened.
recommendation: PLOS ONE's Expression of Concern says Fig. 7 has no LSD1 siRNA data and the transfection controls are poorly described, so hedge the Section 3 'clearest indication' sentence and add independent support for it. The notice also questions the validity and provenance of all the results, so soften the Section 2 survival background and cite the notice. The paper is not retracted, so the citation can stay.
